Home.title: Scheza
Home.tagline: Describe your business. Get a working dashboard in seconds.
Home.description: Tell us your trade, your town, and what you track. We build a fully populated, Ontario-ready dashboard before you ever create an account.

BusinessProfile.title: Business profile
BusinessProfile.subtitle: Enter your company details once. They appear on every invoice you send, so your legal name, tax number, and payment options are always correct.
BusinessProfile.legalNameHint: Your registered business name, exactly as it appears on official documents.
BusinessProfile.operatingNameHint: The name your customers know you by, if different from your legal name.
BusinessProfile.gstHstNumberHint: Leave blank if you are not registered. If you enter a number, add its effective date too.
BusinessProfile.gstHstEffectiveDateHint: The date your GST/HST registration took effect.
BusinessProfile.logoHint: PNG or JPEG, up to 2 MB. Shown on your invoices.
BusinessProfile.mailingAddressHint: Where you receive mail, if different.
BusinessProfile.paymentSubtitle: How your customers can pay you. These appear on every invoice.
BusinessProfile.cardLinkHint: An optional link where customers can pay by card.
BusinessProfile.savedBody: Your company details are ready to use on your invoices.

Import.title: Import your data
Import.subtitle: Bring in your real history from a spreadsheet. We'll read the file and show you what we found before anything is saved.
Import.dropzoneHint: Drag and drop a CSV or Excel file here, or choose a file. Accepted formats: .csv, .xls, .xlsx. Up to 5 MB.
Import.dropzoneActive: Drop your file to upload it.
Import.sheetPickerLabel: This workbook has more than one sheet. Choose which one to read.

Import.previewNote: Nothing has been saved yet. This is just a preview of what we read.

Invoices.listSubtitle: Draft, review, and manage the invoices you bill your customers.
Invoices.emptyBody: Create your first draft to start billing a customer.
Invoices.draftSubtitle: Add the line items you are billing. The subtotal, tax, and total update as you type.
Invoices.customerSubtitle: Link a customer record, or leave blank for a standalone invoice.
Invoices.pickerNoTables: No tables are available to link.
Invoices.provinceHint: Defaults from your business profile. Used later to calculate tax.
Invoices.lineItemsSubtitle: Every draft needs at least one line item.
Invoices.subtotalHint: A running total for reference. Tax applies once your business profile has an effective GST/HST registration.
Invoices.totalsHint: A running total for reference. Confirmed when you issue the invoice.
Invoices.savedBody: Your changes are stored. You can keep editing this draft.
Invoices.discardConfirmBody: This permanently deletes the draft and its line items. This cannot be undone.
Invoices.issueConfirmBody: Issuing assigns a permanent invoice number and freezes the supplier and customer details. Once issued, the invoice cannot be edited or deleted. Corrections are only possible with a credit note.
Invoices.issuedSubtitle: This invoice is issued and can no longer be edited.
Invoices.dueDateHint: Leave blank if this invoice has no due date. A due date lets the list flag it as overdue.
Invoices.markPaidSubtitle: Mark this invoice paid once you receive the money. Scheza never processes or holds funds.
Invoices.markPaidDialogBody: Record how and when you were paid. This marks the invoice as paid; it does not move any money.
Invoices.paymentReferenceHint: An optional note to help you find this payment later.
